w10_T4_001423: In the morning a courier office had 47 minutes of deliveries on its list, and 76 more minutes were added before noon. In the afternoon another 13 minutes were added, bringing the round to a little over two hours. In the evening a second round of exactly the same length was added, making 2 rounds. All the delivery time was then shared equally among 4 drivers, so Ana's share was exactly the same as Ben's. How many minutes of deliveries did Ana get?
w10_T4_001424: In the morning Cara put 71 cents into her jar and then 17 cents more. In the afternoon she added 26 cents. In the evening she added 73 cents, bringing that day's saving to a little under two dollars. She saved exactly the same amount on each of 6 days. How many cents did Cara save over those 6 days?
w10_T4_001432: Cal gets 95 cents a day and spends 73 cents of it on bus fares, which he pays twice a day. He saves the rest for 7 days. His grandmother then adds 28 cents, so his savings are a little under two dollars. His bus route has 15 stops. At the fair every cent he has is worth 9 points on the shooting gallery. How many points can Cal score?
w10_T4_001433: A bakery uses 71 grams of dough for each roll, packs 3 rolls in a bag, and puts 5 bags in an order. It adds 48 grams of seeds and 31 grams of glaze to every order, and lets the dough rest for half an hour. The bakery has 9 ovens. A hotel places 5 orders. How many grams of dough, seeds and glaze go into the hotel's orders?
w10_T4_001434: In the morning Dov had 94 marbles and lost 45 of them in a game. In the afternoon he gave 39 marbles to his sister Eve, who then had more marbles than Dov. The game board is 60 centimetres wide. Each of Dov's remaining marbles is worth 9 points in the club contest. In the evening the club gave him a 39-point bonus. How many points does Dov have?
w10_T4_001440: In the morning a cafe served 6 cups of soup with 175 millilitres in each cup, a little over a litre in all, and then served 78 millilitres more to a child. In the afternoon it served another 52 millilitres. The cafe serves exactly this much soup every day and cleans its pots twice a day. In the evening the owner noted that the cafe had done this for 8 days. How many millilitres of soup did the cafe serve in those 8 days?
w10_T4_001441: Ewa earns 155 cents a day from her paper round. Each day she spends 35 cents on a snack, earns 65 cents walking a neighbour's dog for half an hour, and gets 54 cents from returning bottles, and she saves what is left. She does this 7 days a week for 3 weeks. How many cents does Ewa save?
w10_T4_001444: Fay earns 48 cents an hour helping at a stall and worked 5 hours on Saturday. She received a 65-cent tip. Her friend Gus, who earns less per hour than Fay and has worked there a dozen weeks, paid her back 21 cents. Fay then spent 263 cents on a scarf and 21 cents on a ribbon. How many cents does Fay have left?
w10_T4_001448: In the morning a farm packed 124 eggs on each tray and filled 9 trays. The eggs were shared equally among 3 market stalls. The market is 5 kilometres away. In the afternoon Hal's stall sold 326 eggs. In the evening a neighbour gave Hal's stall 8 eggs, and a late delivery brought 30 more. How many eggs did Hal's stall have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_001449: Ian gets 105 cents a day in pocket money. Every day he spends 18 cents on a bun, earns 48 cents washing dishes, gets 66 cents for weeding, and receives 34 cents from his grandfather, who visits twice a week. He saves everything he has left over each day for 7 days. How many cents does Ian save?
w10_T4_001451: In the morning a lemonade stand had 85 cups ready, and the owner made 53 more. 7 cups were knocked over and spilled. In the afternoon every cup was sold for 7 cents. In the evening a customer came back and left a 25-cent tip. How many cents did the stand take in?
w10_T4_001452: Jen had 169 minutes of talk time, nearly three hours, and the company added 4 bonus minutes. She made a 16-minute call to her dentist and a 74-minute call to her mother. She then spoke to her friend for 57 minutes, about half of which was about football. She bought a top-up of 50 minutes. How many minutes of talk time does Jen have?
w10_T4_001459: Ida is paid 198 cents an hour, but 129 cents of each hour's pay goes to her union, leaving her less than a dollar an hour. She works 7 hours a day for 6 days. Her shift starts at 8. Ida shares her own pay equally among herself and her 5 workmates, keeping 1 of the 6 equal shares, so her workmate Jon gets exactly the same as Ida keeps. Ida then receives a 70-cent tip. At the fair every cent is worth 7 points. How many points can Ida score?
w10_T4_001460: In the morning a bakery had 157 cookies and sold 120 of them. In the afternoon it baked 46 more. In the evening 43 cookies were sold. The remaining cookies were shared equally among 4 children, so Kit got exactly as many as Lu. How many cookies did Kit get?
w10_T4_001465: In the morning Lena runs 3 stretches of 95 minutes each, nearly five hours of running, but she cuts 18 minutes off with a shortcut. She runs this way every morning for 8 days, resting for half an hour afterwards. In the afternoon of the last day she jogs 26 more minutes, and in the evening she runs another 47 minutes. How many minutes has Lena run in total?
w10_T4_001467: Max had 51 dollars. He spent 11 dollars on a book. His friend Nia, who had less money than Max afterwards, paid him back 31 dollars. He then spent 68 dollars on a coat, leaving him 3 dollars, that is three hundred cents. At the arcade every dollar bought 8 tokens. Max shared his tokens equally among 4 games. How many tokens did Max use on the first game?
w10_T4_001474: Ola sows 24 seeds in each row, 3 rows in each bed, and has 5 beds in her garden, which she waters twice a day. She also sowed 66 seeds in pots and 5 seeds in a window box. How many seeds did Ola sow altogether?
w10_T4_001487: A farmer had 41 sheep. He bought 51 more at the spring market. 8 sheep were sold to a neighbour. The farm is 20 hectares. He then bought 80 sheep from a farm that was closing, and 4 lambs were born. How many sheep does the farmer have now?
w10_T4_001492: Pam had 83 cents, less than a dollar. She found 4 cents on the path. She spent 67 cents on a drink. Her brother gave her 15 cents, and her aunt gave her 59 cents. How many cents does Pam have?
w10_T4_001494: Quin earns 231 cents a day at the newsstand plus 16 cents a day in tips, and spends 99 cents a day on lunch. He saves the rest for 8 days, which comes to a little under twelve dollars. His uncle adds 28 cents. Quin then spends 1026 cents on a game. How many cents does Quin have left?
w10_T4_001499: Ola collected 234 cans, but the depot rejected 114 of them. The depot is 3 kilometres away. It paid 7 cents for every can it accepted. Ola shared the money equally among herself, Pat and Quin, so Ola's share was exactly the same as Pat's. Ola's father then gave her 3 cents for every cent in her share. How many cents did Ola get from her father?
w10_T4_001504: In the morning a bakery baked 44 loaves and then 24 more. In the afternoon it baked 62 loaves and then another 13. The bakery has 3 ovens. Every loaf was sold for 5 cents. In the evening a customer left a 37-cent tip. How many cents did the bakery take in?
w10_T4_001505: Rob gets 146 cents a week in pocket money and earns 61 cents a week for chores. Each week he spends 132 cents on comics and gets 74 cents back from returning bottles, which leaves him nearly a dollar and a half. He saves that amount every week for 4 weeks. He then spends 456 cents on a kite. How many cents does Rob have left?
w10_T4_001507: Rex earns 162 cents an hour at the market and works 4 hours a day. He worked 2 days this week, and spent 665 cents on shoes. His father then gave him twice what he had, doubling his money. His friend Sid, who earns less per hour than Rex, paid him back 20 cents. How many cents does Rex have?
w10_T4_001511: Tia had 14 cents. She spent 12 cents on a sweet and lost 1 cent through a hole in her pocket. Her brother gave her 4 cents. At the fair every cent she had bought 2 tokens. A friend then gave her 14 tokens. How many tokens does Tia have?
